notes: «جميعا عن وكيع» closes three co-transmitters into one level; the names after it are written once and apply to every route, so they form the shared tail
«قال أبو كريب حدثنا وكيع» repeats the same route and adds no new link
«لعثمان طهوره» is the service Hamran did for Uthman (a scene); the Uthman who speaks («وقال عثمان حدثنا رسول الله») is the last link
the gloss «قال مسعر أراها العصر» is left out
